ns2:course.label: Economics of Human Resources
ns2:course.description: Study of the economics of personnel with the modern corporation. Topics include hiring, promotion, evaluation, discrimination, raiding, job definition, pay schemes, benefits, and design of work. Prerequisite: LER 593 or equivalent, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: LER 593 or equivalent, or consent of instructor.
